acceptance: an AST test fails when a production go test spawner builds its env any other way than the named projection or ciparity.CIEnv (red on a planted spawner)
every current production go test spawner passes it, pkg/acsassert included
the test's package is in repocontract.Packages() or recorded with a reason
fix: Name the rule once (for example ipcenv.GoTestEnv(extra ...string) or a goTestCommand factory the spawners share), move every production go test spawner onto it or onto ciparity.CIEnv, and add a whole-tree AST test that finds every exec.Command / exec.CommandContext / sysexec call whose program is go with a test subcommand and requires its env to come from the named projection. The test reads the whole tree, so it joins repocontract.Packages() (ADR-0110).
routed_reason: split of go-test-env-projection-pinned: the files that are not protected
summary: Rest of acssuite-lane-env-policy (acceptance 2). The console lane fix/acssuite-run-and-report (2026-10-01) moved acssuite's predicate env, acsrunner (evolve acs run) and both releasepreflight go-test runners onto ipcenv.Scrub, the projection core (task_contract, build_floor_reviewer, phase_bindings_selfcheck) and ship (repocontract) already use; ciparitygate and the composed-tree gate use the stricter allowlist ciparity.CIEnv. Nothing pins the rule: a new exec.Command("go", "test", ...) or sysexec "go" test spawner inherits the lane's EVOLVE_FLEET / cycle-state keys again and false-REDs env-sensitive packages (guards, ship's fleet-off goldens), the 2026-09-14 and cycle-1700 class. pkg/acsassert's GoTests (sysexec.Capture with a nil env) inherits whatever its predicate got, which is now scrubbed by acssuite but not by construction.
title: Pin one go-test environment projection across every production go test spawner with an AST test (lane part)
